name: Empty Collection State
summary: Collection-specific resolved-empty profile that consumes canonical Empty State and one optional Button-or-Link action while the target owns result truth, replacement, recovery, announcements, focus, and data lifecycle.

anatomy.name: rootProfile
anatomy.description: Collection context hook layered on the canonical Empty State ordinary grouping root; it adds no independent role, focus, live semantics, visual system, or interaction.

anatomy.name: emptyState
anatomy.description: Required canonical Empty State root that owns passive centered composition, intrinsic container response, typography, spacing, wrapping, and optional-part collapse.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional canonical decorative icon hidden from assistive technology because the required visible title communicates the state.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible collection-empty title using the canonical element-agnostic Empty State class and a target-selected contextual heading.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Optional concise localized explanation or recovery guidance omitted when blank.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: One optional target-composed canonical Button command or Link navigation. E7 owns no local action label, destination, callback, state, or presentation.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One Collection Empty context profile of canonical Empty State without an independent visual or cause variant.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Canonical Empty State responds to its actual container; E7 adds no public size or breakpoint.

states.name: resolved-empty
states.description: The target has authoritatively resolved that the current collection results region has no content to show and selects this profile instead of loading, error, stale results, or pagination.

behavior.name: canonicalComposition
behavior.description: E7 layers one domain hook on canonical Empty State and delegates all visual anatomy, content resilience, decorative-icon policy, and Button/Link presentation rather than duplicating them.

behavior.name: resolvedCollectionTruth
behavior.description: Only the owning target distinguishes genuinely empty inventory, active-filter or search no-results, and merchandising exclusion. These remain lifecycle facts expressed through truthful content and recovery, never E7 cause variants inferred from missing fixture content, query state, or one count value.

behavior.name: atomicResultReplacement
behavior.description: The target atomically replaces stale Collection Grid and Pagination output and decides which filter/sort controls remain useful. Hidden prior results and actions must not remain focusable beside E7.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: At most one target-supplied canonical Button command or Link navigation is composed. Clear/reset behavior, real destination, history, loading/disabled state, events, analytics, and post-activation focus remain dependency and target ownership.

behavior.name: passiveSemantics
behavior.description: Static or route-rendered E7 is ordinary content with no widget role, focus, tabindex, live region, trap, or custom keyboard model. Under ADR 0236 the host supplies contextual native heading rank outside E7 properties.

behavior.name: dynamicAnnouncement
behavior.description: If an in-place filter, search, removal, or section update produces a qualifying no-results status message, a pre-existing target Status owner announces concise localized output without moving focus or turning every E7 root into a live region.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Canonical logical sizing and wrapping preserve short, long, localized, bidirectional, unbroken, narrow-container, zoomed, forced-color, and token-mode content without E7-specific viewport rules.

behavior.name: noNeutralRuntime
behavior.description: E7 adds no listener, observer, timer, request, storage, analytics, formatter, query parser, layout read, animation, framework dependency, or component-owned asset.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Required non-empty visible title identifying the truthful collection absence; blank input omits the complete profile. The target selects the contextual heading element.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Optional concise localized explanation or useful next step, omitted rather than rendered empty.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: Optional decorative icon mapped into canonical Empty State and hidden because the visible title is text-complete. Meaningful illustration semantics require a different target contract.

properties.name: action
properties.description: One optional target-composed canonical Button command or Link navigation. Fixture label, behavior, destination, icon, disabled/loading state, and callback are not E7 defaults or properties.

accessibility: Render the required non-empty title in the contextual native heading selected by the host under ADR 0236; do not expose heading rank as an E7 property or visual control.
Keep the optional icon decorative and hidden because visible title text carries the meaning; a meaningful illustration requires target-authored alternative text outside this narrow profile.

Compose at most one native canonical Button for a command or Link for navigation and preserve the dependency's accessible name, keyboard, focus, disabled/loading, modified-activation, and forced-color behavior.
Do not represent a clear-filter command as a misleading anchor or invent a fallback URL when the target supplies no real navigation destination.
Do not add role=status, aria-live, focus, tabindex, a landmark, or a custom keyboard model to every static Collection Empty root.
For a qualifying dynamic no-results transition, use one pre-existing target Status owner with concise localized context and avoid duplicating the complete visible title.
Atomically remove or hide stale Grid cards, Pagination, and unusable controls and their focus stops; deliberately preserve useful filter controls when they provide the recovery path.
Do not move focus merely to announce emptiness. The collection coordinator owns deliberate focus after filter commands, final-result removal, section refresh, or route navigation.
Do not use E7 for loading, generic errors, permissions, offline state, or unresolved data; select truthful canonical alternatives.
Preserve long/localized content, bidirectional text, 200 percent zoom, text spacing, forced-color focus visibility, and reduced motion through canonical dependencies.

web.notes: The `.empty-collection` context hook layers on canonical Empty State and one target-composed Button or Link. E7 adds zero visual tokens and zero neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Under E7-A the owning Shopify collection section must distinguish source-inventory empty from filtered/search zero, supply truthful localized content and recovery, and prove atomic filter/Grid/Pagination replacement, URL/history, focus, status and section-refresh behavior.

react.notes: A parent collection results controller selects the canonical Empty State profile and owns data truth, replacement, recovery, status, focus, URL/history, and analytics without local E7 state.

swiftui.notes: Native target maps required title, optional guidance/decorative visual, and one native command or navigation action while the collection coordinator owns truth and announcements.

compose.notes: Native target maps required title, optional guidance/decorative visual, and one native command or navigation action while the collection coordinator owns truth and announcements.
